versions.name: Camp Silver Fir
versions.summary: A Verdugo Hills Council high-adventure outpost camp on the north shore of Huntington Lake in the Sierra National Forest of California, a high-elevation backcountry base for older-Scout treks and mountain-lake aquatics.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council, location, and status all re-verified and corrected. The source mislabeled this as a Greater Los Angeles Area Council camp near Castaic; it is a Verdugo Hills Council high-adventure outpost on the north shore of Huntington Lake near Lakeshore, and city/coordinates were relocated accordingly. Per the council's own page the camp is temporarily closed and rebuilding after wildfire damage, so operating status is recorded as not_operating. Coordinates approximate (Lakeshore locality via OpenStreetMap; the source's Castaic coordinates were discarded); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add with corrections: source council/location were wrong; verified against Verdugo Hills Council's own camp page. Recorded not_operating (temporarily closed, rebuilding after the Creek Fire); camp_type/program_types classified as a high-adventure outpost; features unsurveyed.
